scope: Native Dataviz after Superset removal: dashboard list, editor, chart inspector, filters, Data tab, version history, share, Neva panel, Add to Dataviz from an Agent answer

environment.frontend: Vite dev server on the original checkout, hot reload
environment.backend: host dev processes on the original checkout, development stack (one Compose project)

method: Walked each surface as a first-time user, measured row heights and insets from the DOM, and scored layout, lines/separators, headers and content with an LLM-as-judge rubric before and after fixes

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Dashboard list empty: the native list asked the document store for 200 rows per page; the store allows at most 100, so every workspace was skipped
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Page size 100; the unit fake now rejects pages above 100
defects_found_and_fixed.verified: List shows both editable dashboards in the app

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: After adding a chart, the Dataviz tab still showed the previously open dashboard unless the toast button was used
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Dataviz switches to the destination dashboard as soon as the chart is added
defects_found_and_fixed.verified: Added a chart, opened Dataviz manually, destination dashboard shown

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Destination choice used two filled accent buttons next to an accent primary action; dates used a different format
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Quiet segmented control; dates match the rest of Dataviz

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Axis title showed the engine name outlet_stock_daily.stock_date
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Qualified engine names are labelled by their column in plain words (Stock date)

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: ECharts dropped two of five region labels
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Short category axes keep every label, shortened to its band; the tooltip keeps the full name

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Neva opened over the dashboard by default, so a first visit showed only a chat
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: The panel starts closed on phones; the desktop choice is remembered separately

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: The dashboard name was squeezed to zero width
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Below the narrow breakpoint the state moves into the status line and Ask Neva into the Assistant button
defects_found_and_fixed.verified: Phone screenshot shows title, state and save status

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: A disabled faded Publish button stayed visible when nothing was left to publish
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Publish shows only when there is something to publish

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Header 53 px with a 600-weight title, 12/16 px mixed insets and uneven section rhythm
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: 48 px header aligned to the filter row, 500 weight, 16 px insets, 16 px around separators

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Card metadata wrapped with a dangling separator dot
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Cards size by container (min 18rem) and metadata stays on one line

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Long dataset names wrapped to five lines in the side list
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Two-line clamp with the full name on hover; list header aligned to 48 px

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Boxed rows with second-precision timestamps and no marker for the current or published version
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Hairline-divided rows, short dates, Current and Published markers; Version wording used across Dataviz

remaining_observations: Charts added from an answer keep the question as their title; a shorter title is a manual edit
Adding the same answer twice adds a second chart and dataset rather than reusing the first
The Data tab dataset header uses two lines for long names, so it does not align with the 48 px list header
test_data_created: Personal dashboard 'Sell-out by month' (nova_admin) with two charts from the same Agent answer
